SPILL RESPONSE PROCEDURE — CAUSTIC SODA

Cascade Specialty Chemicals, Portland facility. Revised 14 September 2026.

1. Evacuate the west bay and stop the transfer pump at the wall switch.
2. Put on a face shield, chemical gloves and a rubber apron from the cabinet by the door.
3. Contain the spill with the absorbent socks stored on rack B.
4. Neutralise with citric acid from the spill kit until pH is between 6 and 9.
5. Place the used absorbent in a labelled waste drum and tell the EHS lead.

Report any spill over 5 gallons to Oregon DEQ within 24 hours on 503-229-5696.
Next review due 14 September 2027.
